name: comp-98
title: Animated Plus Toggle
description: A state-driven Button that rotates the Plus icon 135 degrees with a cubic-bezier ease when clicked, using aria-expanded to track state.
use_when: You need a visual toggle that shows open/closed state through icon rotation.
avoid_when: When users expect a plus-to-minus transition rather than rotation.
a11y: aria-expanded reflects toggle state; aria-label changes between Open/Close. Icon is aria-hidden.
